subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01102412ab5af0aca1eebc7651f432176575769bf46c2aec71c4fc1fc0ab6d9b.png]
solution:
When we compare the figures 2 and 3 we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2774bb396dcac4b00450af4c97b16e86cfe0249a1154e05137f2de7c942db7d3.png] ​

We observe that, when we move the dice towards left such that 3 and 6 are visible we find that on the left we have 2 and on the right we have 5 which means they both are opposite to each other. So 2 is the number on the face opposite the face showing 5.

Hence the correct answer is option 2)
